memory_candidates: The encoding flaw in enriched_vecEA2_until and enriched_bypass_since is shared: positive between-zone SSNs are encoded as unbounded temporal operators (Since or Until) at a single endpoint, which provides one bound but loses the other. Both Until and Since directions are blocked by this same issue.

BracketFormula.holds_of_unordered_distinct was incorrectly stated: it assumed witnesses could be permuted freely, but BracketFormula requires strictly increasing witnesses matching point types in a specific order. For n >= 2, witnesses for different SSN types are at model-determined positions that cannot be reordered.

The Since case (existPart_succ_n1_bypass_k0_since) can be structured with by_cases on t_compat and ssn_compat, proving the incompatible cases as Formula.bot contradictions. The ssn_xt_compatible check with false/true (instead of true/false for Until) requires proving order atoms for x < t direction.
